notes.title: Fear & Hope - Devlog Update #5
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884249/dc0015af6b5d4e751fe63d6c3c525aa90c07fa1f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hi all,  [/p][p][/p][p]We're having fun out there and hope you are as well.  [/p][p][/p][p]Super excited to announce that we have officially completed the last 3D model clue of the game. A massive milestone for us that has been 18 months in the making!! 🚀🍾 [/p][p][/p][p]This brings us significantly closer to release of the game which we are targetting towards the end of this year.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884249/efb94f94d040fe6ac2af59749a4967a18f7e9770.png"][/img][/p][p]Expect to hear more from us soon![/p][p][/p][p]All the best, [/p][p]The IS Team[/p]

notes.title: Fear & Hope - Devlog Update #4
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884249/8da2224a50233088875b1066dbfcc099b827421b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hi all,  [/p][p][/p][p]We're having fun out there and hope you are to.  [/p][p][/p][p]In the latest devlog video we've introduced a new weapon management system and battle mechanic for a range of enemies and monsters that are coming to the game. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884249/8316daf1a43b46a8d2adb8ab038fc18973e8d935.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]But that's not all! We've also added another new feature around a food and water game mechanic that has survivalist elements. You'll need to find (or stumble upon) food and water throughout your journey otherwise you may not make it.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884249/4ec0ce4c66177cd53406d4c6f066f710129e69fc.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned for more updates![/p][p][/p][p]All the best, [/p][p]The IS Team[/p]

notes.title: Fear & Hope - Devlog Update #3
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884249/03eb7db18e0c1f830c928a611313f41f87dbea31.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hi all,  [/p][p][/p][p]Hope you're having fun out there.  [/p][p][/p][p]BIG MILESTONE we have completed development of all 3D mini-game puzzles!! 🍾🎉[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884249/635d6beab49fb6d37050e3b566d8db8adbb248e4.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We continue on the long pole in the tent which is a significant backlog of 2D art the game still needs for a full release, plus a little more story writing, music and some finishing touches on sound effects.[/p][p][/p][p]We are making progress though and getting closer each week which is very exciting.[/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned for more updates![/p][p][/p][p]Yours, [/p][p]The IS Team[/p]

notes.title: Fear & Hope - Devlog Update #2
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884249/eadbaeb77dfdb91709d803e5f49c7800b4f772c0.png"][/img]Hi all,

Hope you're having fun out there.

The devlog continues! We are close to wrapping up development of all 3D mini-game puzzles in the game which is a huge milestone for us as every puzzle is like completeing a mini-project!

A short gif from one of the puzzles we have been working on. We'll call it "Maestro Please" for now:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884249/2644e925d61b2b96e28e96abc668e702e418eace.gif"][/img]Until next time.

Love and Respect,
The IS Team[/p]

notes.title: Updated Demo Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884249/35125485ec63b5e4959c98df690feb5b9d4a44a0.png[/img]

Hi all,

We hope you're having fun out there.

Tremendous news - we've updated our demo for Fear & Hope!

Version 1.3 is the latest and it's full of new features including more clues, clue inventory, full screen reading mode, text speed/size controls, load/save and plenty more.

Check it out and let us know what you think!

Cheers,
IS Team

notes.title: Fear & Hope Dev Continues!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884249/3d225613032973a8442ea97b46cc34efa367f78a.png[/img]​

Hi folks,

We're having fun out there and we hope you are to.

Its been awhile since last update, but rest assured the development continues!

​We've updated screenshots to the store page which show a sample of the many new puzzles, clues, features and scenes we have been working on. We've also updated the game's cover image based on a revised marketing push (which as usual we are leaving far too late in the pre-release cycle :) !!).

If interested we also post devlog and progress videos regularly on our social channels (Instagram, X/twitter, Threads and YouTube) so please feel free to check it out and like / connect / subscribe! All our social channel links are available via linktree: https://linktr.ee/imaginings_software.  

​Until next time!

Cheers,
Joel

notes.title: Fear & Hope - Special Next Fest Livestream #2!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884249/3bc15ccbeb36ea3c64e151ad4770f468ba583dd3.png[/img]

Hi folks,

We're having fun out there and hope you are as well.

Come join us for the second of two special livestreams we'll be running as part of Steam's June 2024 Next Fest event!

Sure to be loads of fun playing the game and hanging out. We'll also be taking questions and would love to hear feedback on the demo as well.

Also hopefully by this session we would have learned all the hard lessons from the first livestream (but probably not). ;)

Cheers,
Joel

notes.title: Fear & Hope coming to Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884249/3fdb3a0ba74304f1052d4a4ac050b61f12c2ddb5.png[/img]

Hi folks,

We're having fun out there and we hope you are as well.

We're thrilled to announce that the Fear & Hope demo will be included in Steam's upcoming June Next Fest event! 

If you'd like to take a sneak peek prior, the free public demo is already up and available on the game's Steam store page.

During the event we plan to run a special Next Fest livestream event of the demo (wish us luck as it will be the first livestream event we've ever attempted on Steam!), so keep an eye out for that as well.

Until then wishing you all the best.

Cheers,
Joel

notes.title: Fear and Hope Free Demo!
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We're having fun out there and hope you are doing the same!

After much blood, sweat and tears, we're super excited to announce release of Fear & Hope Free Demo today (as well as a new teaser trailer)! 🥳🥳🚀🚀🍾🍾

Have a play and let us know what you think. 

Full game targetting mid 2024!

Cheers!
Joel
